annotations.title: ERC-20 token risk scan (owner, proxy, liquidity)

description: Heuristic risk screen of an ERC-20 token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon or Avalanche: name, symbol, supply; owner and renounce status; proxy and upgradeability; Sourcify verification; privileged functions in bytecode or verified ABI (mint, pause, blacklist, fee, limit, trading switch); Uniswap v2/v3 and Aerodrome pools with USD depth; risk score 0-100 with a reason per flag. Sources: on-chain reads via PublicNode JSON-RPC, Sourcify. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: Token contract address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).

chain.description: Chain of the token: base (8453), ethereum (1), arbitrum (42161), optimism (10), polygon (137), avalanche (43114). Chain ids and aliases such as eth, arb, op, matic, avax are also accepted.
